fixes.explanation: Magicians show up earlier in Joseph's story, when Pharaoh needed his dream explained (Genesis 41:8). But they're not in this scene, friend. Genesis 47:22 says Joseph "…did not acquire the priests’ portion of the land…" No hat, no rabbit, just priests holding on to their land.

problems.problem: “I see where you got that” and “a name you’d remember” assume the baker remembers the magicians and chose the answer for that reason. Papa Dorin has not been told either thing.
